messages:
aisha_cs: KiteCorp customer reporting our sales-issued credit not reflected; their prod requests are now failing with billing hold. PO KC-2026-042 attached on the SFDC note. Can billing confirm status? :eyes:

sam_s: Do we have the credit attached to the org or just queued in Sales? We sometimes forget to apply to the billing_account_id vs org_id. Any screenshots/IDs?

jordan_ae: I created the credit in the sales promo flow yesterday and added internal note 'apply to upcoming invoices'. PO number is KC-2026-042. Screenshot of sales portal attached in the ticket (screenshot_2026-03-29.png).

aisha_cs: Customer pasted the API error they get: `HTTP 402 Payment Required - billing_hold`. Happening on POST /v1/engines/text/generate after a bunch of successful calls. They say invoice 2026-03-KC-11 still shows balance.

theo_billing: Looking now. I can see a credit record for KiteCorp (50000 USD) but status is `draft` and it's not applied to invoice 2026-03-KC-11. Likely sales created but never finalized. I'll promote to applied, confirm audit.

jordan_ae: Thanks Theo — please include the PO note and any internal reference so legal/accounting can reconcile. We need zero balance before EOD for their release tomorrow.

theo_billing: On it. Applying now. API call I'm running (admin tool):
```
POST /admin/v1/credits/apply
{
  "billing_account": "kc_bacct_8742",
  "amount_cents": 5000000,
  "reason": "Sales contract promo - PO KC-2026-042",
  "apply_to_invoice": "2026-03-KC-11",
  "note": "Applied per Jordan AE request - sales promo"
}
```

billing-bot: Audit: credit cre-9f3a2b applied to invoice 2026-03-KC-11 by theo_billing at 2026-03-29T14:22:10Z. Previous status: draft. New invoice balance: 0. Reference PO: KC-2026-042.

aisha_cs: Confirming with customer now — they say API calls succeed again. They saw token-level error go away. :partyparrot:

jordan_ae: I'll add a note in SFDC: Credit applied, invoice cleared, release greenlit. Please add the PO reference to the invoice line so accounting can match.

oliver_legal: For our records, add contract amendment ID AMND-2026-07 to the internal notes. That links to the credit terms.

theo_billing: Done — added PO KC-2026-042 and AMND-2026-07 to invoice metadata and accounting notes. Closing the billing hold.

aisha_cs: Closing this thread; customer confirmed back-end tests pass. Filing a quick postmortem to remind Sales to finalize credits as `applied` when creating from portal to avoid the draft gap.

jordan_ae: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the AE to update the quick checklist.

aisha_cs: Tagging for visibility: @sam_s @theo_billing @oliver_legal — please keep the PO note in the invoice. Thread closed.
